app.appTitle: KeyHub · web keyboard driver (open-source community edition)

gate.desc: This site is an open-source web replica of the official desktop drivers for SinoWealth-platform keyboards, not affiliated with any keyboard vendor. The device protocol comes from open-source reverse engineering of keyboards sharing the same chip (AULA F75 / F87 Pro); model data, language packs and light frames are parsed from each vendor's official driver package (LEOBOG, YINDIAO, etc. — see the model registry for sources).
gate.warn: Some write paths are untested against real keyboards; writing configs to a real device may behave unexpectedly (lighting glitches, corrupted settings, etc.). Use at your own risk.
gate.agree: I understand this is an unofficial open-source implementation and I accept all risks of using it
gate.demoTitle: Demo mode: pick a model — a demo card is added on the home page

conn.btHint: Bluetooth is not supported — use the 2.4G dongle or a cable.
conn.heroHint: The model is detected automatically once connected (wired or 2.4G dongle; no Bluetooth).
conn.noGrant: No keyboard is granted to this page yet: permissions are per origin (address+port). Reopen the original URL, or re-grant once via "Add new device"
conn.openFailed: Granted keyboard interfaces failed to open (possibly held by another program). Close it and click the device card to retry
conn.noWebHID: This browser has no WebHID (needs Chrome/Edge over localhost or HTTPS). Try demo mode from the top-right instead.
conn.unknownPsd: Unknown PSD; no model matched, pick it manually
conn.rejected: The identify command was rejected by this interface. If the picker listed multiple rows, retry with another one (grants accumulate); see the HID console, or pick the model manually
conn.noReply: No reply to the identify query: on 2.4G press a key to wake the keyboard first; when wired, if the picker lists several rows grant them one by one and retry (grants accumulate; the command channel is usually on another row); otherwise pick the model manually
conn.noCh13: Note: this interface has no 0x13 output channel, so lighting/config cannot be written to the keyboard. Prefer the 2.4G dongle
conn.candNote: The identify signature matches multiple registry models (vendors reused the same signature). Pick the one matching your keyboard:
conn.demoNote: Pick a model to explore the full UI and light simulation.
conn.logEmpty: No logs yet — HID traffic appears here once a keyboard is connected.
conn.psdNoMatch: The reported PSD matches no known model. Reconnect with another transport or pick the model manually:
conn.contributeNote: This keyboard isn't accurately identified by the registry yet. Two ways to contribute (see CONTRIBUTING.md):
conn.contributeDriver: ① Official driver available (most keyboards on this platform ship one): convert it with tools/convert.mjs and open a PR — about 10 minutes;
conn.contributeKb: ② Keyboard only: export the diagnostics bundle below and open an adapter-request issue — contributors with the hardware/driver will pick it up.
conn.issueCopied: Issue template copied (includes identified PSD). Paste it on the repo Issues page
conn.manualNote: Pick your model; you can also switch the transport or retry auto-detection.
conn.actualModel: The connected keyboard identifies as {actual} (card: {card}); opening the actual model
conn.autoFail: Auto-connect failed: {reason}. If you used this site on another address before, reopen that URL.
conn.autoFailNoHid: this browser has no WebHID (needs Chrome/Edge)
conn.autoFailInsecure: this address is not a secure context (WebHID needs localhost or HTTPS)
conn.noReport: None of the {n} granted interfaces declares the identify report. If the picker still has other rows, retry with another one; otherwise this keyboard's identify interface may be unreachable from the browser. Pick the model manually and share the HID console log
conn.psdMulti: This keyboard's PSD matches {n} models ({list}, highlighted below). Pick the one that matches your keyboard:
conn.autoFailCount: Automatic identification failed ({n} interface(s), name "{name}"). Reconnect with another transport or pick the model manually:

keys.mouseFullNote: L/R/M/wheel-up can be written (same value as L, so they may act as L); fwd/back/wheel-down/double-click are not implemented yet.
keys.cmdNote: Win-lock/KB-lock take effect via "Write to keyboard"; Reset stays local to this page.
keys.noMacroYet: No macros yet — create one on the Macros page
keys.resetLayerConfirm: Restore every key on this layer to the driver defaults?
keys.clickKeyHint: Click a key on the keyboard to view & assign
keys.writeNoChannel: This interface does not support key-map writes (needs the 2.4G dongle or a wired feature-frame interface). Reconnect
keys.writeFailed: Key-map write failed; see the debug panel log
keys.badgeTip: FN-layer functions show as blue badges on the keyboard; knob models (e.g. Hi75 RGB) auto-switch the knob to custom mode when it is remapped.
keys.pageNote: Assignments go live via "Write to keyboard" on this page (all layers at once); macro contents are still written from the Macros page.

light.colorfulTip: Colorful is on — colors are random; turn it off to pick your own
light.perKeyNote: Drag across keys to paint — the keyboard preview updates live; "Write per-key" sends them to the device.

macro.selectMacro: Select a macro on the left
macro.unmappedTip: No HID mapping — ignored when written to the keyboard
macro.emptyMacro: Empty macro — click "Record" and tap keys

macro.writeFailed: Macro write failed; see the debug panel log

screen.pipette: Pick color (I) — from the composed frame
screen.dragText: Drag text on the canvas to reposition.
screen.uploadImg: Upload image / GIF to the image layer
screen.gifFillHint: Fills the screen; overflow is cropped
screen.gifFitHint: Shows it all; black bars where short
screen.clearAllFrames: Clear all frames — reset to a single black frame
screen.demoNoWrite: Demo mode writes nothing. Connect a keyboard first
screen.needWired: Screen transfer needs a wired interface. Plug in the USB cable and retry
screen.unifiedDelay: Firmware supports one global frame delay; the 1st frame's interval will be used (see HID log)
screen.noIface: No screen interface found. Reconnect and grant every device row
screen.noAck: Keyboard did not ack the start command (SetGIFParam). Replug and retry; see the HID log
screen.burnIncomplete: Burn incomplete; see the HID log
screen.finishNoAck: Finish not acked. Retry or re-burn; see the HID log
screen.layersTip: Three layers stack bottom-up: image → paint → text; the eye toggles a layer (hidden layers are not burned); each action only touches its own layer.
screen.wiredOnlyNote: You are on the 2.4G wireless link — screen image transfer needs a USB cable. This unlocks automatically once the wired interface joins; never-granted devices must reconnect via "Add new device" on the home page.
screen.gifReplaceNote: Replaces all {cur} current frame(s) (paint & text included) with {gif} GIF frame(s).
screen.unifiedNote: frame delays vary; unified to the mode {ms}ms (firmware supports one global delay)
screen.framesTip: The keyboard loops these frames; up to {max} — scroll horizontally for more.
screen.clearConfirm: Delete all {n} frame(s) and reset to a single black frame. Continue?
screen.burnConfirm: Burn {n} looping frames to the keyboard screen (overwrites current content). Continue?
screen.loopRecv: The keyboard will loop the {n} frames it received
